name: Magyaregregy (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Magyaregregy (a quartered shield of green, blue and grey with an oak bough, a crown, a sunflower and a wall) above a yellow scroll inscribed MAGYAREGREGY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
